KOGA: Fwahahaha!\pA mere child like you dares to
challenge me?\pThe very idea makes me shiver
with mirth!\pVery well, I shall show you true
terror as a ninja master.\pPoison brings steady doom.
Sleep renders foes helpless.\pDespair to the creeping horror of
POISON-type POKéMON!{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_RG_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}
Humph!\nYou have proven your worth!\pHere!\nTake the SOULBADGE!
When afflicted by TOXIC, a POKéMON\nsuffers more and more.\pIt suffers worsening damage as the\nbattle wears on!\pIt will surely terrorize foes!

Now that you have the SOULBADGE,
the DEFENSE of your POKéMON rises.\pIt also lets you SURF outside of
battle.\pAh!
Take this, too!
{PLAYER} received TM06\nfrom KOGA.
Sealed within that TM06 lies\nTOXIC!\pIt is a secret technique dating\nback some four hundred years.
Make space for this, child!
Strength isn't the key for POKéMON.\nDo you understand this?\pPOKéMON is about strategy!\pI'll show you how strategy can\nbeat brute strength.
What?\nExtraordinary!
So, you mix brawn with brains?\nGood strategy!\pThat's remarkable for a child\nTRAINER.
I was a magician once upon a time.\pBut I dreamt of becoming a ninja,\nso I joined this GYM.
I'm done for!
Even though I've lost, I will keep\ntraining according to the teachings\lof KOGA, my ninja master.
Let's see you beat my special\ntechniques!
You had me fooled!
I like poison and sleep techniques,\nas they linger after battle!
Stop right there!\pThe famed invisible walls of\nFUCHSIA GYM have you frustrated?
Whoa!\nYou've got it!
You impressed me!\nHere's a hint!\pLook very closely for gaps in the\ninvisible walls!
I also study the way of the ninja\nwith Master KOGA!\pNinja have a long history of using\nanimals!
Awoo!
I still have much to learn.
Master KOGA comes from a long line\nof ninjas.\pWhat did you descend from?
You're more skilled than I'd\nthought!
Where there is light, there is\nshadow!\pLight and shadow!\nWhich do you choose?

Yo!
Champ in the making!\pFUCHSIA GYM is a tricked-up place.
It's riddled with invisible walls!\pKOGA might appear close, but he's
blocked off.\pYou have to find gaps in the walls
to reach him.
It's amazing how ninja can terrify,\neven now!
FUCHSIA POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: KOGA\pWINNING TRAINERS:\n{RIVAL}
FUCHSIA POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: KOGA\pWINNING TRAINERS:\n{RIVAL}, {PLAYER}
